counterfactual.method: exact in-memory reversal of the single per_op gate guard through kir.authoring.operation_check_gate; the emitter registry is not touched

delta_shape: one emitted line per operation-stage gate in per_op isolation; no declaration, create, post, readback or refusal marker moved
emission_source_snapshot_scope: named diagnostic read set at migration; not a complete dependency closure or a historical source reconstruction

goldens.note: test_golden compiles at the default atomic isolation, so a per_op-only delta cannot move a golden file; the equality with the parent record's golden hashes is the measurement

limits: reviewed reference pin for an intentional behaviour change; not native backward compatibility
no Revit, no C# execution, no Roslyn run backs this record
the refused operation's message is preserved in __results[oid]['refused'], not in postcondition_violations
atomic isolation was already leak-free by construction (refusal returns before __post is published) and is unchanged

parent.source_pin_scope: retained historical claims; this record asserts only its own before/after manifests

reason: C-1 (independent audit, 2026-09-06): in per_op isolation the operation-stage gate threw its refusal while LEAVING the refused operation's message in the program-wide __post list, which report mode publishes as __results['postcondition_violations']. A rolled back operation therefore reported a violation of the COMMITTED program and the D1 consumer called the whole write VIOLATED. The gate now lifts its message into a local, removes exactly its own range [__operationPostStart_s, Count) and throws the lifted message; neighbour lines below the marker are untouched.
